/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/timberlin.title: Timberline UHDZ

/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/timberlin.title: Timberline NS
/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/timberlin.description: Explore Timberline NS shingle colors, nominal specifications and manufacturer warranty information with Roof King.

children.text: Stylish yet practically priced shingles provide value and performance with a natural shadow effect.

/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/timberlin.title: Timberline AS II
/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/timberlin.description: Explore Timberline AS II shingle colors, nominal specifications and manufacturer warranty information with Roof King.

children.text: Timberline AS II Shingles with UL 2218 Class 4 impact resistance give your roof a fighting chance in hail-prone areas1 and help
protect it against wind and blue-green algae too.

/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/timberlin.title: Timberline HDZ RS
/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/timberlin.description: Explore Timberline HDZ RS shingle colors, nominal specifications and manufacturer warranty information with Roof King.

children.text: Timberline HDZ RS shingles can be used to comply with 2022 Title 24, Part 6 Cool Roof Requirements of the California Code of Regulations and are rated by the Cool Roof Rating Council (CRRC).

/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/camelot-i.title: Camelot II
/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/camelot-i.description: Explore Camelot II shingle colors, nominal specifications and manufacturer warranty information with Roof King.

children.text: An artisan-crafted slate-like shape and custom palette conjure the romance of European architecture.

/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/woodland/.title: Woodland
/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/woodland/.description: Explore Woodland shingle colors, nominal specifications and manufacturer warranty information with Roof King.

children.text: The stylish look of hand-cut European shingles with 21st century style at an incredibly affordable price.

/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/grand-seq.title: Grand Sequoia
/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/grand-seq.description: Explore Grand Sequoia shingle colors, nominal specifications and manufacturer warranty information with Roof King.

children.text: Artisan-crafted shapes combined with oversized tabs result in a sophisticated beauty unmatched by typical shingles.

/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/grand-seq.title: Grand Sequoia RS
/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/grand-seq.description: Explore Grand Sequoia RS shingle colors, nominal specifications and manufacturer warranty information with Roof King.

children.text: The cool roof you need with the distinctive style you crave.

/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/grand-seq.title: Grand Sequoia AS
/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/grand-seq.description: Explore Grand Sequoia AS shingle colors, nominal specifications and manufacturer warranty information with Roof King.

children.text: The look of rugged wood shakes with the protection of UL 2218 Class 4 impact resistance.

/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/royal-sov.title: Royal Sovereign
/products/roofing/shingles/gaf/royal-sov.description: Explore Royal Sovereign shingle colors, nominal specifications and manufacturer warranty information with Roof King.

children.text: Beautiful. Reliable. Affordable. Simple, timeless beauty at a price you can afford. When the value is everything, living the dream has never looked so good.

/products/roofing/shingles/owens-corning.title: Owens Corning Duration
/products/roofing/shingles/owens-corning.description: Explore Owens Corning Duration: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Duration combines a dimensional shingle profile with the SureNail reinforced fastening strip. Its published Class 3 impact classification and genuine color photographs make it a useful starting point for comparing the Duration family.

/products/roofing/shingles/owens-corning.title: Owens Corning Duration Designer
/products/roofing/shingles/owens-corning.description: Explore Owens Corning Duration Designer: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Duration Designer uses distinctive color blends to create a more varied dimensional roof appearance. It shares the Duration family’s SureNail fastening design, with a published Class 3 impact classification.

/products/roofing/shingles/owens-corning.title: Owens Corning Duration FLEX
/products/roofing/shingles/owens-corning.description: Explore Owens Corning Duration FLEX: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Duration FLEX uses a polymer-modified asphalt formulation and has a published Class 4 impact classification. Compare its genuine color photos with the other Duration lines while keeping the impact rating separate from hail-damage warranty coverage.

/products/roofing/shingles/owens-corning.title: Owens Corning Duration STORM
/products/roofing/shingles/owens-corning.description: Explore Owens Corning Duration STORM: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Duration STORM combines a reinforced nailing area with a published Class 4 impact classification. The rating describes a controlled test; flashing, deck condition and the complete roof assembly still matter in a storm.

/products/roofing/shingles/owens-corning.title: Owens Corning Oakridge
/products/roofing/shingles/owens-corning.description: Explore Owens Corning Oakridge: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Oakridge is a laminated fiberglass asphalt shingle with a warm, dimensional appearance. It offers a different fastening design from Duration, so compare the product specification as well as the color.

/products/siding/vinyl/alside/charter-oa.title: Charter Oak Reinforced Premium Vinyl Siding
/products/siding/vinyl/alside/charter-oa.description: Explore Charter Oak Reinforced Premium Vinyl Siding: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Oak-grain horizontal panels combine a .046-inch wall with the TriBeam reinforcement design. Charter Oak suits broad elevations where straight courses and deep shadow lines are central to the appearance.

breadcrumbs.label: Charter Oak Reinforced Premium Vinyl Siding

/products/siding/vinyl/alside/odyssey-pl.title: Odyssey Plus Premium Vinyl Siding
/products/siding/vinyl/alside/odyssey-pl.description: Explore Odyssey Plus Premium Vinyl Siding: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Odyssey Plus pairs .044-inch vinyl panels with SecureLock connections. Four horizontal profiles let you choose a narrower or wider course and a flat clapboard face or a recessed Dutch-lap edge.

/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/polar-wa.title: Polar Wall Plus! Insulated Vinyl Siding
/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/polar-wa.description: Explore Polar Wall Plus! Insulated Vinyl Siding: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Polar Wall Plus combines a vinyl face with insulating foam backing. Its thicker assembly changes the depth at windows and corners, so the trim and transitions need to be planned with the panel rather than treated as an afterthought.

breadcrumbs.label: Polar Wall Plus! Insulated Vinyl Siding

/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/great-ba.title: Great Barrier Vinyl Siding
/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/great-ba.description: Explore Great Barrier Vinyl Siding: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Great Barrier offers .046-inch panels with extended 16.66-foot lengths available to reduce joints across long walls. Its three-quarter-inch projection creates a stronger shadow than a flatter siding profile.

/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/sturdipl.title: SturdiPlank Single 7"
/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/sturdipl.description: Explore SturdiPlank Single 7": color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: SturdiPlank S7 uses a single seven-inch exposure instead of multiple narrow courses molded into one panel. The wider face and three-quarter-inch projection give horizontal walls a more substantial clapboard rhythm.

/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/cedar-kn.title: Cedar Knolls Vinyl Siding
/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/cedar-kn.description: Explore Cedar Knolls Vinyl Siding: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Cedar Knolls brings a hand-cut cedar appearance to .044-inch vinyl siding. Its five-eighths-inch projection and three profile choices make it useful for coordinating different wall widths without changing the overall material.

/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/sterling.title: Sterling Vinyl Siding
/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/sterling.description: Explore Sterling Vinyl Siding: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Sterling is distinguished by its .048-inch panel and NailRIGHT fastening layout. The five-eighths-inch projection gives the wall visible depth; the fastening guide helps establish the intended attachment pattern.

/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/woodsman.title: Woodsman Select Vinyl Siding
/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/woodsman.description: Explore Woodsman Select Vinyl Siding: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Woodsman Select uses a rough-sawn cedar appearance with four clapboard and Dutch-lap choices. Its .042-inch panels offer a different specification from the thicker Great Barrier and Cedar Knolls lines, even when the color names overlap.

/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/summit-m.title: Summit Manor Vinyl Siding
/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/summit-m.description: Explore Summit Manor Vinyl Siding: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Summit Manor offers a .040-inch panel with a half-inch projection. Choose between two clapboard widths and a four-and-a-half-inch Dutch-lap profile to set the scale of the horizontal courses.

/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/rustic-h.title: Rustic Hill shakes & shingles
/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/rustic-h.description: Explore Rustic Hill shakes & shingles: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Rustic Hill is a polypropylene shake-and-shingle family, rather than conventional horizontal PVC siding. Cape Cod shingles, traditional shakes and hand-split shakes have different textures and panel thicknesses, making them distinct choices for gables or full walls.

/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/home-acc.title: Home Accents shakes & shingles
/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/home-acc.description: Explore Home Accents shakes & shingles: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Home Accents offers staggered shake, split shake and perfection shingle looks at a seven-inch exposure. Staggered edges create an irregular pattern, while perfection shingles give the wall a more orderly finish.

/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/cambridg.title: Cambridge Beaded Vinyl Siding
/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/cambridg.description: Explore Cambridge Beaded Vinyl Siding: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Cambridge Beaded creates a traditional U-grooved bead along each course. Its brushed low-gloss surface and five-eighths-inch projection produce a different appearance from a cedar-grain Dutch lap.

/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/board-an.title: Board & Batten Vinyl Siding
/products/siding/vinyl/norandex/board-an.description: Explore Board & Batten Vinyl Siding: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: This vertical profile pairs a wide, flat board with a narrow raised batten. Seven-inch exposure gives gables and full elevations a regular vertical pattern, with a .052-inch panel and half-inch projection.

/products/siding/vinyl/variform/heritage.title: Heritage Cedar
/products/siding/vinyl/variform/heritage.description: Explore Heritage Cedar: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Heritage Cedar offers molded shingle, shake and rounded-edge profiles with texture between individual shingles as well as on the face. The choice of edge pattern changes the character of a gable or accent wall; thickness varies by profile.

/products/siding/vinyl/variform/vortex-e.title: Vortex Extreme
/products/siding/vinyl/variform/vortex-e.description: Explore Vortex Extreme: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Vortex Extreme combines a .046-inch panel with a reinforced fastening and locking design. Extended lengths can reduce visible joints on wide walls, while the split-cedar appearance keeps the courses visually textured.

/products/siding/vinyl/variform/variform.title: Variform Board & Batten
/products/siding/vinyl/variform/variform.description: Explore Variform Board & Batten: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Variform Board & Batten uses an extra-thick .048-inch panel for a vertical board-and-batten look. Use the repeated raised battens to emphasize height on a gable or carry one consistent pattern across a full elevation.

/products/siding/vinyl/variform/camden-p.title: Camden Pointe
/products/siding/vinyl/variform/camden-p.description: Explore Camden Pointe: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Camden Pointe combines a .044-inch panel with cedar texture and pronounced shadow lines. Its rollover panel lock and nail hem are part of the attachment design, alongside the profile and color choices that shape the finished wall.

/products/siding/vinyl/variform/american.title: American Herald
/products/siding/vinyl/variform/american.description: Explore American Herald: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: American Herald uses .044-inch panels with the appearance of natural sawn cedar. Through-panel color helps make surface scratches less conspicuous, while the nail hem and panel lock provide the intended attachment arrangement.

/products/siding/vinyl/variform/ashton-h.title: Ashton Heights
/products/siding/vinyl/variform/ashton-h.description: Explore Ashton Heights: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Ashton Heights uses .042-inch vinyl panels with a double-staggered nail hem. It offers a different panel specification from Camden Pointe, so compare the actual profile and attachment details alongside the shared color palette.

/products/siding/vinyl/variform/contract.title: Contractor’s Choice
/products/siding/vinyl/variform/contract.description: Explore Contractor’s Choice: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Contractor’s Choice is a .040-inch vinyl line for traditional horizontal siding. Compare course width, matching corners and trim before choosing it, since those details determine the proportions of the wall as much as the color does.

/products/siding/vinyl/variform/victoria.title: Victoria Harbor
/products/siding/vinyl/variform/victoria.description: Explore Victoria Harbor: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Victoria Harbor uses a six-and-a-half-inch beaded face to create a traditional horizontal pattern. Its brushed finish and full bead produce a cleaner, finer shadow detail than deeply embossed cedar-grain siding.

/products/roofing/shingles/iko/dynasty/.title: Dynasty Performance Shingles
/products/roofing/shingles/iko/dynasty/.description: Explore Dynasty Performance Shingles: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: A wide ArmourZone nailing surface and Class 3 impact classification distinguish Dynasty from a basic architectural shingle. Its larger exposure creates a pronounced dimensional pattern.

/products/roofing/shingles/iko/nordic/.title: Nordic Performance Shingles
/products/roofing/shingles/iko/nordic/.description: Explore Nordic Performance Shingles: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Nordic combines a reinforced nailing area with a Class 4 impact classification. It is an option for homeowners comparing laboratory impact performance as well as the look of a dimensional roof.

/products/roofing/shingles/iko/dynasty-c.title: Dynasty Cool Colors Plus Performance Shingles
/products/roofing/shingles/iko/dynasty-c.description: Explore Dynasty Cool Colors Plus Performance Shingles: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Dynasty Cool Colors Plus combines the Dynasty profile with reflective color blends. Its cool-roof designation relates to the specific color and rating, and regional availability needs confirmation.

breadcrumbs.label: Dynasty Cool Colors Plus Performance Shingles

/products/roofing/shingles/iko/armoursha.title: Armourshake Designer Shingles
/products/roofing/shingles/iko/armoursha.description: Explore Armourshake Designer Shingles: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Armourshake uses a heavy, dimensional profile to suggest the uneven edges and depth of wood shakes. Different impact-rated versions are listed, so the exact package classification matters.

/products/roofing/shingles/iko/royal-est.title: Royal Estate Designer Shingles
/products/roofing/shingles/iko/royal-est.description: Explore Royal Estate Designer Shingles: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Royal Estate creates a slate-like pattern in asphalt shingles. Its relatively compact exposure and sculpted shadow lines suit homeowners who want a different appearance from a conventional dimensional shingle.

/products/roofing/shingles/iko/crowne-sl.title: Crowne Slate Designer Shingles
/products/roofing/shingles/iko/crowne-sl.description: Explore Crowne Slate Designer Shingles: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Crowne Slate uses a broad ten-inch exposure and a slate-inspired shape. The large visible face creates a distinctive roof pattern, with a published Class 4 impact classification.

/products/roofing/shingles/iko/cambridge.title: Cambridge Architectural Shingles
/products/roofing/shingles/iko/cambridge.description: Explore Cambridge Architectural Shingles: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Cambridge is a dimensional fiberglass asphalt shingle with a wood-shake-inspired pattern. Its current manufacturer page lists Class 3 impact resistance; confirm the classification on the material supplied.

/products/roofing/shingles/iko/cambridge.title: Cambridge Cool Colors Plus Architectural Shingles
/products/roofing/shingles/iko/cambridge.description: Explore Cambridge Cool Colors Plus Architectural Shingles: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Cambridge Cool Colors Plus adds reflective color choices to the Cambridge architectural profile. Compare the exact color’s roof rating and local supply rather than treating every Cambridge color as a cool-roof product.

breadcrumbs.label: Cambridge Cool Colors Plus Architectural Shingles

/products/decking/composite/trex/signatu.title: Trex Signature Decking
/products/decking/composite/trex/signatu.description: Explore Trex Signature Decking: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Trex Signature decking emphasizes a finely detailed natural appearance in composite boards. It is a separate decking product from Trex Signature railing; confirm current local supply and the exact decking specification before planning a new project.

/products/decking/composite/trex/lineage.title: Trex Transcend Lineage Composite Decking
/products/decking/composite/trex/lineage.description: Explore Trex Transcend Lineage Composite Decking: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Trex Transcend Lineage offers a refined grain pattern in seven colors with SunComfortable technology. Its heat-mitigating design is compared with Trex’s original boards; the surface can still become hot in direct sunlight.

/products/decking/composite/trex/transce.title: Trex Transcend Composite Decking
/products/decking/composite/trex/transce.description: Explore Trex Transcend Composite Decking: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Trex Transcend combines a pronounced wood-grain surface with five multi-tonal colors. The protective shell reduces routine finishing work, while grooved and square-edge profiles serve different fastening and edge-detail needs.

/products/decking/composite/trex/select/.title: Trex Select Composite Decking
/products/decking/composite/trex/select/.description: Explore Trex Select Composite Decking: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Trex Select offers a more restrained grain pattern and a 35-year residential fade-and-stain warranty. Its newer Whiskey Barrel, Malted Barley and Millstone colors include heat-mitigating technology; that feature does not apply automatically to every Select color.

/products/decking/composite/trex/enhance.title: Trex Enhance Composite Decking
/products/decking/composite/trex/enhance.description: Explore Trex Enhance Composite Decking: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Trex Enhance uses a scalloped underside to reduce board weight. Ten colors span solid and blended looks, with heat-mitigating technology on Cinnamon Cove, Golden Hour, Honey Grove, Pebble Beach and Tide Pool.

/products/decking/composite/trex/refuge/.title: Trex Refuge PVC Decking
/products/decking/composite/trex/refuge/.description: Explore Trex Refuge PVC Decking: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Trex Refuge is PVC decking, with a wire-brushed surface in Martis Valley and Point Reyes. Its published Class A flame-spread rating concerns this decking product; it is different from a roof-assembly fire classification and does not make a home fireproof.

/products/siding/engineered-wood/lp-smar.title: LP SmartSide Shake Lap Siding
/products/siding/engineered-wood/lp-smar.description: Explore LP SmartSide Shake Lap Siding: product view choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: LP SmartSide Shake Lap Siding creates cedar-style shadow lines in treated engineered wood. It offers an alternative to individual cedar shakes for accent walls and gables, with Cedar and Brushed Smooth texture choices.

/products/siding/engineered-wood/lp-smar.title: LP SmartSide Lap Siding
/products/siding/engineered-wood/lp-smar.description: Explore LP SmartSide Lap Siding: product view choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: LP SmartSide Lap Siding uses treated engineered wood in long horizontal boards. Cedar texture emphasizes grain; Brushed Smooth creates a quieter painted surface. Primed boards allow custom paint, while ExpertFinish provides a factory-applied color option.

/products/siding/engineered-wood/lp-smar.title: LP SmartSide Trim & Fascia
/products/siding/engineered-wood/lp-smar.description: Explore LP SmartSide Trim & Fascia: product view choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: LP SmartSide Trim & Fascia frames windows, corners and roof edges in treated engineered wood. Board width and thickness affect the depth of those transitions, so trim needs to be selected alongside the siding and soffit.

/products/siding/engineered-wood/lp-smar.title: LP SmartSide Nickel Gap Siding
/products/siding/engineered-wood/lp-smar.description: Explore LP SmartSide Nickel Gap Siding: product view choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: LP SmartSide Nickel Gap creates a defined narrow reveal between boards. Cedar and Brushed Smooth textures let that repeated joint read as rustic or contemporary, with primed and prefinished choices.

/products/siding/engineered-wood/lp-smar.title: LP SmartSide Soffit
/products/siding/engineered-wood/lp-smar.description: Explore LP SmartSide Soffit: product view choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: LP SmartSide Soffit finishes the underside of the roof overhang. Cedar and Brushed Smooth textures coordinate with the wall finish, while the soffit selection also needs to preserve the roof’s planned intake ventilation.

/products/siding/engineered-wood/lp-smar.title: LP SmartSide Panel & Vertical Siding
/products/siding/engineered-wood/lp-smar.description: Explore LP SmartSide Panel & Vertical Siding: product view choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: LP SmartSide Panel & Vertical Siding creates broad wall surfaces that can be detailed with trim for a board-and-batten effect. Panel joints, flashing and trim placement should be coordinated so the finished pattern and drainage work together.

/products/siding/fiber-cement/james-hard.title: Hardie Plank
/products/siding/fiber-cement/james-hard.description: Explore Hardie Plank: texture choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Hardie Plank is fiber-cement lap siding with smooth, cedar-textured and beaded variations. Course exposure and corner trim determine the scale of the finished wall; the texture selector shows the manufacturer’s actual surface samples.

/products/siding/fiber-cement/james-hard.title: Hardie Panel
/products/siding/fiber-cement/james-hard.description: Explore Hardie Panel: texture choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Hardie Panel creates broad vertical fiber-cement surfaces. Smooth, wood-textured and stucco-like options offer different appearances, and added battens can create a farmhouse pattern without changing the panel material.

/products/siding/fiber-cement/james-hard.title: Hardie Artisan Siding
/products/siding/fiber-cement/james-hard.description: Explore Hardie Artisan Siding: texture choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Hardie Artisan uses extra-thick fiber-cement boards and deep shadow lines for a more pronounced architectural finish. The line is primed for paint, making the final coating and joint treatment part of the design decision.

/products/siding/fiber-cement/james-hard.title: Hardie Shingle
/products/siding/fiber-cement/james-hard.description: Explore Hardie Shingle: texture choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Hardie Shingle gives fiber cement a cedar-shake appearance. Straight-edge panels create an orderly course, while staggered-edge panels make the silhouette more irregular; either can distinguish a gable from the main lap siding.

/products/siding/fiber-cement/james-hard.title: Hardie Architectural Panel
/products/siding/fiber-cement/james-hard.description: Explore Hardie Architectural Panel: texture choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Hardie Architectural Panel uses contemporary textures and clean panel lines for an intentional facade pattern. It is primed for your paint color, so panel layout, expressed joints and the finish should be designed together.

/products/siding/fiber-cement/james-hard.title: Hardie Trim Batten Boards
/products/siding/fiber-cement/james-hard.description: Explore Hardie Trim Batten Boards: texture choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Hardie Trim Batten Boards create the raised vertical strips in a board-and-batten exterior. They pair with Hardie Panel, with smooth or textured surfaces to coordinate the battens and the wall behind them.

/products/gutters/guards/alu-rex/doublep.title: DoublePro continuous hanger
/products/gutters/guards/alu-rex/doublep.description: Explore DoublePro continuous hanger: system choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: DoublePro is a dual-layer continuous hanger installed with new gutters. It combines gutter support and debris screening in one system, making it a different choice from a screen added later to an existing gutter.

/products/gutters/guards/alu-rex/t-rex/.title: T-Rex continuous hanger
/products/gutters/guards/alu-rex/t-rex/.description: Explore T-Rex continuous hanger: system choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: T-Rex is a continuous hanger that supports a new gutter along its length rather than at individual hanger points. Its perforated cover also screens debris; gutter pitch, outlets and downspout capacity still determine the drainage route.

/products/gutters/guards/alu-rex/gutterc.title: Gutter Clean Pro
/products/gutters/guards/alu-rex/gutterc.description: Explore Gutter Clean Pro: system choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Gutter Clean Pro is a retrofit guard for suitable existing gutters. Its Flex-Seal rear detail helps close the space behind the guard, while the screening surface reduces debris entry into the gutter trough.

/products/gutters/guards/alu-rex/gutter-.title: Gutter Clean
/products/gutters/guards/alu-rex/gutter-.description: Explore Gutter Clean: system choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Gutter Clean is an aluminum debris-screening option for existing gutters. It does not replace assessment of gutter condition, slope or downspouts; repair those issues before selecting a guard.

/products/siding/vinyl/exterior-portfoli.title: Exterior Portfolio Carolina Sands
/products/siding/vinyl/exterior-portfoli.description: Explore Exterior Portfolio Carolina Sands: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Carolina Sands uses a six-and-a-half-inch beaded profile with a low-gloss brushed surface. The .044-inch panel and five-eighths-inch profile edge give a restrained traditional look distinct from deep cedar-grain Dutch lap.

/products/siding/vinyl/exterior-portfoli.title: Exterior Portfolio EP Board & Batten
/products/siding/vinyl/exterior-portfoli.description: Explore Exterior Portfolio EP Board & Batten: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Exterior Portfolio Board & Batten gives walls a repeated vertical pattern with a .046-inch panel. Its low-gloss cedar appearance works as either a full cladding or an accent against horizontal lap siding.

/products/siding/vinyl/exterior-portfoli.title: Exterior Portfolio Premium Pointe
/products/siding/vinyl/exterior-portfoli.description: Explore Exterior Portfolio Premium Pointe: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Premium Pointe combines a .046-inch panel with a full rollover nail hem and a low-gloss cedar finish. Extended 16-foot lengths are offered to reduce visible seams; the current manufacturer color matrix shown here lists Dutch-lap variants.

/products/siding/vinyl/exterior-portfoli.title: Exterior Portfolio Market Square
/products/siding/vinyl/exterior-portfoli.description: Explore Exterior Portfolio Market Square: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Market Square uses a .044-inch panel with a partial rollover nail hem and teardrop lock. Lap and Dutch-lap profiles create different shadow patterns, with color availability tied to the actual profile selected.

/products/siding/vinyl/exterior-portfoli.title: Exterior Portfolio Parkview
/products/siding/vinyl/exterior-portfoli.description: Explore Exterior Portfolio Parkview: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Parkview uses a .042-inch panel with a low-luster woodgrain surface. The published page describes several horizontal profiles; the current manufacturer color matrix shown here contains Dutch-lap selections.

/products/siding/vinyl/exterior-portfoli.title: Exterior Portfolio Elm Grove
/products/siding/vinyl/exterior-portfoli.description: Explore Exterior Portfolio Elm Grove: color choices, product specifications and manufacturer warranty information.

children.text: Elm Grove brings a raised woodgrain texture to a .040-inch vinyl panel. Lap and Dutch-lap variants give it a traditional horizontal appearance, with a partial rollover nail hem in the attachment design.

/products/decking/composite/trex/signatu.title: Trex Signature aluminum railing
/products/decking/composite/trex/signatu.description: A slender aluminum frame and vertical balusters keep the perimeter visually light.

children.text: A slender aluminum frame and vertical balusters keep the perimeter visually light. Compare post positions and stair transitions alongside the rail finish so the entire run reads as one system.

/products/decking/composite/trex/signatu.title: Trex Signature glass railing
/products/decking/composite/trex/signatu.description: Glass infill opens sightlines while the surrounding aluminum frame defines each section.

children.text: Glass infill opens sightlines while the surrounding aluminum frame defines each section. Panel sizing, support and stair details need to be planned together; glass is a distinct infill choice, not a substitute inserted into an unrelated rail kit.

/products/decking/composite/trex/signatu.title: Trex Signature mesh railing
/products/decking/composite/trex/signatu.description: Mesh infill gives the deck a more architectural, industrial appearance.

children.text: Mesh infill gives the deck a more architectural, industrial appearance. The perimeter frame remains part of the design, with dedicated infill and mounting components selected for level and stair sections.

/products/decking/composite/trex/signatu.title: Trex Signature Rod Rail
/products/decking/composite/trex/signatu.description: Horizontal rods create long visual lines across the deck edge.

children.text: Horizontal rods create long visual lines across the deck edge. Rail sections, posts and stair components must be selected as the Rod Rail assembly rather than mixed with cable or vertical-baluster parts.

/products/decking/composite/trex/signatu.title: Trex Signature X-Series cable railing
/products/decking/composite/trex/signatu.description: Cable infill offers an open view with narrow horizontal lines.

children.text: Cable infill offers an open view with narrow horizontal lines. End conditions, cable connections and the supporting posts are central to the system, so the layout should be resolved before deck boards and post locations are finalized.

/products/decking/composite/trex/signatu.title: Trex Signature X-Series frameless glass railing
/products/decking/composite/trex/signatu.description: Frameless glass places the emphasis on the view beyond the deck.

children.text: Frameless glass places the emphasis on the view beyond the deck. The glass panels and supporting X-Series posts work as a specified assembly, with the stair and corner arrangements considered alongside the level runs.

breadcrumbs.label: Trex Signature X-Series frameless glass railing

/products/decking/composite/trex/transce.title: Trex Transcend composite railing
/products/decking/composite/trex/transce.description: Transcend provides a substantial, traditional rail profile with coordinated posts, caps and infill choices.

children.text: Transcend provides a substantial, traditional rail profile with coordinated posts, caps and infill choices. It suits a deck where the railing is a visible design feature rather than a minimal outline.

/products/decking/composite/trex/select-.title: Trex Select Classic railing
/products/decking/composite/trex/select-.description: Select Classic combines familiar rail proportions with metal balusters.

children.text: Select Classic combines familiar rail proportions with metal balusters. Review the rail and post colors as an assembly, including the stair sections, rather than choosing parts from photographs of different configurations.

/products/decking/composite/trex/select-.title: Trex Select T-Rail
/products/decking/composite/trex/select-.description: The T-shaped top rail gives this Select option a distinct hand profile.

children.text: The T-shaped top rail gives this Select option a distinct hand profile. Its rails, reinforcement and balusters are a specific configuration; the connections should be reviewed with the posts and stair layout.

/products/decking/composite/trex/select-.title: Trex Select aluminum railing
/products/decking/composite/trex/select-.description: Select aluminum railing offers a metal alternative within the Select range.

children.text: Select aluminum railing offers a metal alternative within the Select range. Its slim sections suit a clean perimeter, with matching rail kits, mounting hardware and gates considered as a complete layout.

/products/decking/composite/trex/select-.title: Trex Select mesh railing
/products/decking/composite/trex/select-.description: Select mesh changes the look of the infill while retaining a defined perimeter rail.

children.text: Select mesh changes the look of the infill while retaining a defined perimeter rail. The mesh panels and accessory kits should be matched to their specified rail and post assembly, including separate stair details.

/products/decking/composite/trex/enhance.title: Trex Enhance steel railing
/products/decking/composite/trex/enhance.description: Enhance steel railing provides a simple metal perimeter with a more open view than broad solid rails.

children.text: Enhance steel railing provides a simple metal perimeter with a more open view than broad solid rails. Consider its finish, mounting hardware and stair kits together when comparing it with the composite Enhance option.

/products/decking/composite/trex/enhance.title: Trex Enhance composite railing
/products/decking/composite/trex/enhance.description: Enhance composite railing uses a traditional top-and-bottom rail arrangement.

children.text: Enhance composite railing uses a traditional top-and-bottom rail arrangement. It is a separate choice from Enhance steel railing, with its own rails, post sleeves and installation components.

/products/decking/composite/trex/fascia/.title: Trex Fascia boards
/products/decking/composite/trex/fascia/.description: Fascia covers the deck rim and gives stair edges a finished appearance.

children.text: Fascia covers the deck rim and gives stair edges a finished appearance. It is a vertical finishing board, not the structural rim joist or a substitute for walking-surface decking. Dedicated fascia fasteners accommodate movement without treating the board like a deck plank.

/products/decking/composite/trex/hideawa.title: Trex Hideaway fasteners and tools
/products/decking/composite/trex/hideawa.description: Hideaway includes fastening choices for grooved decking, face-fastened boards and fascia.

children.text: Hideaway includes fastening choices for grooved decking, face-fastened boards and fascia. Hidden clips attach at the board edges; screws and plugs address other locations. Selecting the fastener by board profile and application avoids using a fascia connection in the walking surface.

/products/decking/composite/trex/deck-li.title: Trex DeckLighting
/products/decking/composite/trex/deck-li.description: Deck lighting helps define steps, railings and the edges of outdoor living areas after dark.

children.text: Deck lighting helps define steps, railings and the edges of outdoor living areas after dark. Plan fixture locations, wiring access and the power supply before enclosing posts or finishing the underside of the deck.

/products/decking/composite/trex/rainesc.title: Trex RainEscape under-deck drainage
/products/decking/composite/trex/rainesc.description: RainEscape collects water below the deck boards and directs it away through troughs and downspouts.

children.text: RainEscape collects water below the deck boards and directs it away through troughs and downspouts. It is most useful when you want to use the space under an elevated deck. Drainage routing and access need to be resolved before the walking surface is installed.

/products/gutters/guards/leaffilter/gutt.title: LeafFilter gutter protection
/products/gutters/guards/leaffilter/gutt.description: LeafFilter combines a fine stainless-steel screen, a supporting uPVC frame and internal structural hangers.

children.text: LeafFilter combines a fine stainless-steel screen, a supporting uPVC frame and internal structural hangers. The screen helps separate debris from water at the gutter opening. Existing gutters still need sound attachments, suitable outlets and a clear discharge route; a screen cannot correct a deteriorated gutter or failed fascia.

/products/siding/vinyl/ply-gem/cedar-dim.title: Ply Gem Cedar Dimensions
/products/siding/vinyl/ply-gem/cedar-dim.description: Cedar Dimensions uses molded polypropylene panels to create the irregular edges and grain associated with cedar shingles and shakes. The family includes straight shingle, hand-split shake and half-round looks, so it can be used to change the character of a gable, porch or full wall rather than simply change its color.

children.text: Cedar Dimensions uses molded polypropylene panels to create the irregular edges and grain associated with cedar shingles and shakes. The family includes straight shingle, hand-split shake and half-round looks, so it can be used to change the character of a gable, porch or full wall rather than simply change its color.

The profiles are separate panels with their own dimensions and matching corner pieces. Nominal thickness ranges from .080 to .100 inch across the family. A Double 7 shingle and a Double 9 shake should not be treated as interchangeable when calculating quantities or ordering trim.

Choose the panel profile before the accessories. Ply Gem lists dedicated cedar-panel starter strips and profile-specific corners; those details give the wall a more convincing finish than using an unrelated lap-siding accessory. Color availability also varies by profile.

/products/siding/vinyl/ply-gem/dimension.title: Ply Gem Dimensions
/products/siding/vinyl/ply-gem/dimension.description: Dimensions is the .044-inch nominal-thickness lap siding in the Ply Gem Performance Collection. Its ⅝-inch profile creates a deeper shadow line, making the individual courses more defined across a broad wall. The folded nail hem and oversized lock are parts of the panel design rather than added accessories.

children.text: Dimensions is the .044-inch nominal-thickness lap siding in the Ply Gem Performance Collection. Its ⅝-inch profile creates a deeper shadow line, making the individual courses more defined across a broad wall. The folded nail hem and oversized lock are parts of the panel design rather than added accessories.

Choose Double 4 traditional lap for a straightforward clapboard look or Double 4½ Dutch lap for a beveled course with a more pronounced shadow. The profiles have different panel lengths, which matters when planning seams around windows, corners and long wall runs.

Compare a full sample against the trim and roof color outdoors. The family palette includes solid and cedar-inspired finishes, but the chosen color still needs to be checked against the exact panel profile. Thickness alone is not a whole-wall wind rating; fastening and the supporting wall also matter.

/products/siding/vinyl/ply-gem/progressi.title: Ply Gem Progressions
/products/siding/vinyl/ply-gem/progressi.description: Progressions combines a fine-grained, painted-wood appearance with .042-inch nominal-thickness vinyl panels. Its ½-inch profile gives the courses definition without using the deeper profile of Dimensions. It is a useful family to compare when you want several lap-width choices in one collection.

children.text: Progressions combines a fine-grained, painted-wood appearance with .042-inch nominal-thickness vinyl panels. Its ½-inch profile gives the courses definition without using the deeper profile of Dimensions. It is a useful family to compare when you want several lap-width choices in one collection.

The four profiles include Double 4 and Double 5 traditional lap plus Double 4½ and Double 5 Dutch lap. A wider exposure changes the number of horizontal lines across the wall; Dutch lap adds a beveled shadow at the top of each course. Those differences are more useful to judge on a full sample than on a small color chip.

Panel length and color selection vary by profile. Plan the preferred exposure, seams and corner details together, then compare the exact product in the installation estimate. Darker colors are not necessarily available across every Progressions profile.

/products/siding/vinyl/ply-gem/performan.title: Ply Gem Performance Board + Batten
/products/siding/vinyl/ply-gem/performan.description: Performance Board + Batten creates vertical lines with a 5½-inch board face and a 1½-inch batten. It can emphasize the height of a gable or become the main exterior pattern. The .048-inch nominal panel thickness and 9⁄16-inch profile distinguish it from the horizontal lap products in the collection.

children.text: Performance Board + Batten creates vertical lines with a 5½-inch board face and a 1½-inch batten. It can emphasize the height of a gable or become the main exterior pattern. The .048-inch nominal panel thickness and 9⁄16-inch profile distinguish it from the horizontal lap products in the collection.

Ply Gem lists a 10-foot panel length. On taller walls, horizontal breaks and transitions need to be designed rather than left as an incidental seam. The way the vertical panels meet a roofline, window head or lower siding material affects both the appearance and the drainage detail.

Starting and finishing a vertical panel is different from starting horizontal lap siding. Match the base channel, corners and opening details to this panel orientation. Review the color on a physical sample, especially where board-and-batten will sit beside another siding profile.

/products/siding/vinyl/ply-gem/transform.title: Ply Gem Transformations
/products/siding/vinyl/ply-gem/transform.description: Transformations is the .040-inch nominal-thickness lap siding family in the Ply Gem Performance Collection. A ½-inch profile and defined locking system provide a familiar clapboard or Dutch-lap appearance. Its smaller family color palette makes it a straightforward starting point for a conventional exterior.

children.text: Transformations is the .040-inch nominal-thickness lap siding family in the Ply Gem Performance Collection. A ½-inch profile and defined locking system provide a familiar clapboard or Dutch-lap appearance. Its smaller family color palette makes it a straightforward starting point for a conventional exterior.

Choose Double 4 or Double 5 traditional lap for flat course lines, or Double 4½ Dutch lap for a beveled shadow. These options differ in exposure and panel length, so the profile should be identified by name in the product selection rather than described only as vinyl siding.

Discuss wall preparation, flashing, trim and fastening alongside the panel. A lower nominal thickness does not remove those installation steps. The finished result depends on the complete wall assembly, including the condition behind the old siding and how the new panels connect at openings and edges.
